description: Long pale bones tied off in a bundle. A Palehusk was carrying them, which raises questions about the string.
lore: Fourteen gold for the bones, which is generous, and nothing whatever for the cord, which is the part everyone actually looks at.

A [[monsters/malformed_creature|Palehusk]] was carrying it. That is not the strange part — they carry things, and going through what a broken one leaves is reading rather than robbing. The strange part is the knot. A ropemaker on the black rock road was shown one and named it without hesitating: a load-hitch, thrown left over right and dressed down, the knot you use when you mean to carry a weight a long way and want it riding quiet on your back. It is not a knot a hand arrives at by accident. Somebody was taught it.
The crackers untie them. They could cut them. They untie them.
gm_notes: A Hollowed thing running a hand's craft it has no inside left to have learned. Sits beside the locket and the ring in the Palehusk record; still no name has been read off one.
